themes_detail.label: Construction Lead Dust Surge
themes_detail.summary: Construction lead dust complaints spiked to 3 this week versus a baseline of 0.2 per week over the prior 8 weeks (1400% increase, z-score 6.35), signaling potential widespread lead remediation or demolition activity without adequate containment in a district with significant pre-1978 housing stock.
evidence: 3 construction lead dust complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.35)
709 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (591 alterations, 47 new buildings, 8 full demolitions) — high construction activity
Lower East Side / Chinatown has significant pre-1978 housing stock vulnerable to lead exposure
reporting_angles: Which construction projects are active in the district and are they following lead-safe work practices?
Interview residents in proximity to active construction sites about dust, health concerns, and notification from contractors

themes_detail.label: Dead and Dying Trees — Rapid Decline
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints quadrupled to 4 this week compared to 0.4 per week baseline (967% spike, z-score 7.49), alongside a parallel spike in overgrown tree/branch complaints (3 this week vs. 0.2 baseline), suggesting either acute environmental stress or deferred Parks maintenance across the district.
evidence: 4 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.49, 967% spike)
3 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.35, 1100% spike)
Community board has standing budget request for 'reconstruct or upgrade park or amenity' — suggests chronic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Walk the neighborhood to document tree conditions; map complaints against specific park/streetscape locations
Interview Parks Department on maintenance schedules and budget constraints in CD 103

themes_detail.label: Public Urination Crisis Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Public urination complaints exploded to 3 last week versus a baseline of 0.1 per week (2300% increase, z-score 8.69), the sharpest proportional spike in the data, pointing to either acute homelessness, substance abuse, or sanitation facility inadequacy in high-foot-traffic areas.
evidence: 3 urinating in public complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.69, 2300% spike)
Overlaps with standing CB budget request for 'improve trash removal and cleanliness' and 'increase vacant lot cleaning'
Lower East Side / Chinatown high foot traffic, dense residential, limited public restroom access
reporting_angles: Identify geographic hotspots for the complaints; interview business owners and residents about impact on storefronts and pedestrian safety
Investigate public restroom availability in the district; speak to city on homeless outreach and sanitation services

themes_detail.label: Street Sign Damage Wave
themes_detail.summary: Damaged street sign complaints jumped to 5 last week from a baseline of 0.6 per week (700% increase, z-score 9.04), a high-severity statistical anomaly that could signal traffic hazards, vehicle impact patterns, or deferred infrastructure maintenance.
evidence: 5 street sign damaged complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 9.04, 700% spike)
Complements ongoing spike in illegal parking (1509 complaints over 90 days, top 3 category) and for-hire vehicle complaints (628 complaints)
Traffic signal condition complaints also elevated at 386 over 90 days
reporting_angles: Map the 5 damaged sign locations; investigate whether pattern correlates with high vehicle traffic, double-parking, or Citi Bike/micro-mobility activity
Assess DOT response time for sign repairs in the district

themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Outbreak
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 7 two weeks ago versus a baseline of 0.5 per week (1300% increase, z-score 6.5), suggesting a specific campaign or actor posting unlicensed advertisements across the neighborhood.
evidence: 7 illegal posting complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 6.5, 1300% spike)
Complements standing CB request for 'improve trash removal and cleanliness'
No follow-up data showing whether spike has sustained or resolved
reporting_angles: Document what is being posted (political, commercial, spam) and across which neighborhoods/blocks
Verify whether a single bad actor or coordinated campaign; check with Sanitation on removal response
